message: No detected input validation: There is no validation of the structure, type, or value ranges of the incoming paramDict; missing or empty values are silently replaced with 0 but no schema or range checks are performed.
No detected untrusted source handling: Model files are loaded from local paths via pickle without any checksum, signature, or integrity verification, and no remote data sources are used in this code.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is present anywhere in the pipeline code shown.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads serialized models via pickle.load (in loadMVDDFromFile) and pickle.dump without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify model integrity before use.

No detected label distribution validation: The training code uses StratifiedKFold which preserves class proportions during splitting, but there is no explicit check or validation of label distribution or class balance before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no backdoor detection, trigger analysis, activation-pattern inspection, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries or mechanisms (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) are imported or applied in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While cross-validation splits are used, there is no held-out test set isolation enforced, no signed/hashed evaluation data, and no independent verification mechanism to prevent metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The paramDict is passed directly to predictScore/getModelPrediction with no shape, type, range, or schema validation; only an empty-string-to-zero replacement exists deep inside getModelPrediction, which is not a proper sanitization layer.

No detected output bounds checks: The score returned by predictScore is cast to int and used in if/elif branches, but there is no guard against NaN, None, out-of-range values (e.g., score outside 1–5), or unexpected return types before the result is returned to the caller.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses a Multi-Valued Decision Diagram (MVDD) classifier, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
